Rain Alert: ਪੰਜਾਬ ਅਤੇ ਚੰਡੀਗੜ੍ਹ ‘ਚ ਮਾਨਸੂਨ ਸਰਗਰਮ, ਅੱਜ ਭਾਰੀ ਮੀਂਹ ਦਾ ਅਲਰਟ ਜਾਰੀ

ਚੰਡੀਗੜ੍ਹ, 31 ਜੁਲਾਈ 2026

ਪੂਰੇ ਉੱਤਰੀ ਭਾਰਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਾਨਸੂਨ ਇੱਕ ਵਾਰ ਫਿਰ ਪੂਰੀ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਸਰਗਰਮ ਹੋ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ। ਪੰਜਾਬ, ਚੰਡੀਗੜ੍ਹ, ਹਰਿਆਣਾ, ਹਿਮਾਚਲ ਪ੍ਰਦੇਸ਼ ਅਤੇ ਹੋਰ ਕਈ ਸੂਬਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਿਛਲੇ ਕੁਝ ਦਿਨਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਲਗਾਤਾਰ ਮੀਂਹ ਪੈ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ। ਕਈ ਇਲਾਕਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੜ੍ਹ ਵਰਗੇ ਹਾਲਾਤ, ਸੜਕਾਂ ‘ਤੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਭਰਨ ਅਤੇ ਤੇਜ਼ ਹਵਾਵਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਦੀ ਆਵਾਜਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵਿਤ ਹੋ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ।

ਪੰਜਾਬ ਅਤੇ ਚੰਡੀਗੜ੍ਹ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੀ ਬੀਤੀ ਰਾਤ ਤੋਂ ਮੌਸਮ ਨੇ ਕਰਵਟ ਬਦਲੀ ਹੈ। ਕਈ ਜ਼ਿਲ੍ਹਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਦਰਮਿਆਨੇ ਤੋਂ ਭਾਰੀ ਮੀਂਹ ਦੀ ਰਿਪੋਰਟ ਮਿਲੀ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਕਾਰਨ ਤਾਪਮਾਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਗਿਰਾਵਟ ਦਰਜ ਕੀਤੀ ਗਈ ਅਤੇ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਗਰਮੀ ਤੋਂ ਰਾਹਤ ਮਿਲੀ। ਹਾਲਾਂਕਿ, ਕਈ ਨੀਵੇਂ ਇਲਾਕਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਾਣੀ ਭਰਨ ਕਾਰਨ ਆਵਾਜਾਈ ਵਿੱਚ ਦਿੱਕਤਾਂ ਵੀ ਸਾਹਮਣੇ ਆਈਆਂ ਹਨ।

ਮੌਸਮ ਵਿਭਾਗ ਨੇ ਅੱਜ 31 ਜੁਲਾਈ ਨੂੰ ਵੀ ਪੰਜਾਬ ਅਤੇ ਚੰਡੀਗੜ੍ਹ ਦੇ ਵੱਖ-ਵੱਖ ਹਿੱਸਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਭਾਰੀ ਮੀਂਹ ਪੈਣ ਦੀ ਚਿਤਾਵਨੀ ਜਾਰੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਹੈ। ਵਿਭਾਗ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਕੁਝ ਥਾਵਾਂ ‘ਤੇ ਤੇਜ਼ ਹਵਾਵਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਗਰਜ-ਚਮਕ ਨਾਲ ਮੀਂਹ ਪੈ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਕਾਰਨ ਹੜ੍ਹ ਵਰਗੇ ਹਾਲਾਤ ਬਣਨ ਦੀ ਸੰਭਾਵਨਾ ਤੋਂ ਇਨਕਾਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ।

ਪ੍ਰਸ਼ਾਸਨ ਅਤੇ ਮੌਸਮ ਵਿਭਾਗ ਨੇ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਰਹਿਣ ਦੀ ਅਪੀਲ ਕੀਤੀ ਹੈ। ਨੀਵੇਂ ਇਲਾਕਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਾਣੀ ਭਰਨ ਅਤੇ ਫ਼ਸਲਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਨੁਕਸਾਨ ਪਹੁੰਚਣ ਦਾ ਖ਼ਤਰਾ ਜਤਾਇਆ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ। ਕਿਸਾਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਈਆਂ ਫ਼ਸਲਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਖੇਤੀਬਾੜੀ ਦੇ ਸਾਜ਼ੋ-ਸਾਮਾਨ ਨੂੰ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਅਤ ਥਾਵਾਂ ‘ਤੇ ਰੱਖਣ ਦੀ ਸਲਾਹ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਗਈ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਹੀ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪਾਣੀ ਭਰੀਆਂ ਥਾਵਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਦੂਰ ਰਹਿਣ, ਬਿਜਲੀ ਦੇ ਖੰਭਿਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਕਮਜ਼ੋਰ ਇਮਾਰਤਾਂ ਦੇ ਨੇੜੇ ਨਾ ਜਾਣ ਅਤੇ ਲੋੜ ਪੈਣ ‘ਤੇ ਹੀ ਘਰਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਹਰ ਨਿਕਲਣ ਦੀ ਹਦਾਇਤ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਗਈ ਹੈ।

ਮੌਸਮ ਮਾਹਿਰਾਂ ਦਾ ਕਹਿਣਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਆਉਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਕੁਝ ਦਿਨਾਂ ਤੱਕ ਮਾਨਸੂਨ ਦੀ ਸਰਗਰਮੀ ਜਾਰੀ ਰਹਿ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਈ ਇਲਾਕਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੋਰ ਮੀਂਹ ਪੈਣ ਦੀ ਸੰਭਾਵਨਾ ਬਣੀ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ।

BY KHUSHDEEP SINGH
PUBLISHED ON JUL 31, 2026 12:22 PM IST

ਚੰਡੀਗੜ੍ਹ (ਸੱਚ ਕਹੂੰ ਨਿਊਜ਼/ਹਿੰ.ਸ.)। ਪੰਜਾਬ ਤੇ ਚੰਡੀਗੜ੍ਹ ’ਚ ਮਾਨਸੂਨ ਇੱਕ ਵਾਰ ਫਿਰ ਸਰਗਰਮ ਹੋਣ ਜਾ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ। ਮੌਸਮ ਵਿਗਿਆਨ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਚੰਡੀਗੜ੍ਹ ਵੱਲੋਂ 31 ਜੁਲਾਈ ਤੋਂ 3 ਅਗਸਤ ਤੱਕ ਭਾਰੀ ਮੀਂਹ ਦਾ ਅਲਰਟ ਜਾਰੀ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ। ਅੱਜ 31 ਜੁਲਾਈ ਨੂੰ ਪਠਾਨਕੋਟ, ਗੁਰਦਾਸਪੁਰ, ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਸਰ ਤੇ ਹੁਸ਼ਿਆਰਪੁਰ ’ਚ ਭਾਰੀ ਤੋਂ ਬਹੁਤ ਭਾਰੀ ਮੀਂਹ ਪੈਣ ਦੀ ਸੰਭਾਵਨਾ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਇਲਾਵਾ ਤਰਨਤਾਰਨ, ਨਵਾਂਸ਼ਹਿਰ (ਸ਼ਹੀਦ ਭਗਤ ਸਿੰਘ ਨਗਰ), ਕਪੂਰਥਲਾ, ਜਲੰਧਰ, ਰੂਪਨਗਰ ਤੇ ਐਸਏਐਸ ਨਗਰ (ਮੋਹਾਲੀ) ’ਚ ਵੀ ਮੀਂਹ ਨੂੰ ਲੈ ਕੇ ਚਿਤਾਵਨੀ ਜਾਰੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਗਈ ਹੈ। ਮੌਸਮ ਵਿਗਿਆਨ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਚੰਡੀਗੜ੍ਹ ਦੇ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਪੰਜਾਬ ਦੇ ਜ਼ਿਆਦਾ ਤੋਂ ਜ਼ਿਆਦਾ ਤਾਪਮਾਨ ’ਚ 0.3 ਡਿਗਰੀ ਸੈਲਸੀਅਸ ਦੀ ਗਿਰਾਵਟ ਦਰਜ ਕੀਤੀ ਗਈ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਸੂਬੇ ਦਾ ਤਾਪਮਾਨ ਆਮ ਦੇ ਨੇੜੇ ਪਹੁੰਚ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ। ਫਰੀਦਕੋਟ ’ਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ 37.8 ਡਿਗਰੀ ਸੈਲਸੀਅਸ ਤਾਪਮਾਨ ਦਰਜ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ।

ਮੌਸਮ ਵਿਗਿਆਨ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਚੰਡੀਗੜ੍ਹ ਦੇ ਡਾਇਰੈਕਟਰ ਸੁਰਿੰਦਰ ਪਾਲ ਮੁਤਾਬਕ ਮੱਧ ਪ੍ਰਦੇਸ਼ ਤੇ ਵਿਦਰਭ ਉੱਪਰ ਬਣੀ ਪੱਛਮੀ ਗੜਬੜੀ ਇਸ ਸਮੇਂ ਮਹਾਰਾਸ਼ਟਰ, ਗੁਜਰਾਤ ਤੇ ਰਾਜਸਥਾਨ ’ਚ ਮੀਂਹ ਲਿਆ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵ ਕਾਰਨ ਮਾਨਸੂਨ ਟਰਫ ਇਸ ਸਮੇਂ ਪੰਜਾਬ ਤੋਂ ਦੱਖਣ ਵੱਲ ਬਣੀ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ। ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਕਿ ਪੰਜਾਬ ਉੱਪਰ ਸਰਗਰਮ ਪੱਛਮੀ ਵਿਗਾੜ (ਵੈਸਟਰਨ ਡਿਸਟਰਬੈਂਸ) ਹੁਣ ਉੱਤਰੀ ਹਰਿਆਣਾ ਵੱਲ ਖਿਸਕ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਕਾਰਨ ਅਗਲੇ 24 ਘੰਟਿਆਂ ਦੌਰਾਨ ਪੰਜਾਬ ਤੇ ਚੰਡੀਗੜ੍ਹ ’ਚ ਬਹੁਤ ਤੇਜ਼ ਮੀਂਹ ਪੈਣ ਦੀ ਸੰਭਾਵਨਾ ਘੱਟ ਹੈ। 31 ਜੁਲਾਈ ਨੂੰ ਪੰਜਾਬ ਤੇ ਚੰਡੀਗੜ੍ਹ ਦੇ ਜ਼ਿਆਦਾਤਰ ਹਿੱਸਿਆਂ ’ਚ ਰੁਕ-ਰੁਕ ਕੇ ਹਲਕੀ ਤੋਂ ਦਰਮਿਆਨੀ ਬਾਰਿਸ਼ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਦੌਰਾਨ ਕਈ ਥਾਵਾਂ ’ਤੇ ਗਰਜ-ਚਮਕ ਵੀ ਵੇਖਣ ਨੂੰ ਮਿਲ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ। ਸੂਬੇ ਦੇ ਸਰਹੱਦੀ ਤੇ ਉੱਤਰੀ ਜ਼ਿਲ੍ਹਿਆਂ ਪਠਾਨਕੋਟ, ਗੁਰਦਾਸਪੁਰ, ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਸਰ ਤੇ ਹੁਸ਼ਿਆਰਪੁਰ ’ਚ ਕੁਝ ਥਾਵਾਂ ’ਤੇ ਭਾਰੀ ਮੀਂਹ ਪੈਣ ਦੀ ਸੰਭਾਵਨਾ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਇਲਾਵਾ ਮੋਹਾਲੀ, ਰੂਪਨਗਰ, ਜਲੰਧਰ, ਕਪੂਰਥਲਾ, ਤਰਨਤਾਰਨ ਤੇ ਨਵਾਂਸ਼ਹਿਰ ’ਚ ਵੀ ਕੁਝ ਥਾਵਾਂ ’ਤੇ ਭਾਰੀ ਮੀਂਹ ਪੈ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। Punjab Weather

উত্তরবঙ্গের একাধিক জেলায় ভারী থেকে অতি ভারী বৃষ্টির পূর্বাভাস। আলিপুরদুয়ার ও জলপাইগুড়িতে কমলা সতর্কতা, মঙ্গলবার থেকে কলকাতা-সহ দক্ষিণবঙ্গেও সক্রিয় হবে বর্ষা।
আলিপুরদুয়ার ও জলপাইগুড়িতে অতি ভারী বৃষ্টির পূর্বাভাস। মঙ্গলবার থেকে কলকাতা-সহ দক্ষিণবঙ্গেও সক্রিয় হবে বর্ষা।

উত্তরবঙ্গে ফের দুর্যোগের পূর্বাভাস দিল আলিপুর আবহাওয়া দপ্তর (Alipore Meteorological Department)। আগামী কয়েকদিন উত্তরবঙ্গের একাধিক জেলায় ভারী থেকে অতি ভারী বৃষ্টির সম্ভাবনা রয়েছে। বিশেষ করে আলিপুরদুয়ার ও জলপাইগুড়ি জেলায় রবিবার ও সোমবারের জন্য জারি করা হয়েছে কমলা সতর্কতা (Orange Alert)। অতিবৃষ্টির জেরে পাহাড়ি এলাকায় ধস, নদীর জলস্তর বৃদ্ধি এবং নিচু এলাকায় জল জমার আশঙ্কার কথাও জানিয়েছে হাওয়া অফিস। অন্যদিকে, দক্ষিণবঙ্গে আপাতত বৃষ্টির দাপট কম থাকলেও মঙ্গলবার থেকে কলকাতাসহ একাধিক জেলায় বৃষ্টি বাড়বে বলে পূর্বাভাস দেওয়া হয়েছে।

বর্তমানে গভীর নিম্নচাপটি মধ্যপ্রদেশের দিকে সরে যাওয়ায় পশ্চিমবঙ্গে তার সরাসরি প্রভাব নেই। ফলে শুক্রবার দক্ষিণবঙ্গের অধিকাংশ এলাকায় বিক্ষিপ্তভাবে হালকা থেকে মাঝারি বৃষ্টির সম্ভাবনা রয়েছে। বজ্রবিদ্যুৎসহ বৃষ্টির হলুদ সতর্কতা (Yellow Alert) জারি হয়েছে পশ্চিম বর্ধমান, বীরভূম, মুর্শিদাবাদ, নদিয়া, উত্তর ২৪ পরগনা এবং দক্ষিণ ২৪ পরগনা জেলায়।

আবহাওয়া দপ্তরের পূর্বাভাস অনুযায়ী, শনিবার থেকে সোমবার পর্যন্ত দক্ষিণবঙ্গে বৃষ্টির পরিমাণ তুলনামূলকভাবে কম থাকবে। তবে মঙ্গলবার থেকে আবহাওয়ার পরিবর্তন হবে। বীরভূম ও মুর্শিদাবাদে ভারী বৃষ্টির সম্ভাবনায় ইতিমধ্যেই হলুদ সতর্কতা জারি করা হয়েছে। একই সঙ্গে কলকাতা ও সংলগ্ন জেলাগুলিতেও বৃষ্টির পরিমাণ বাড়তে পারে।

উত্তরবঙ্গে শুক্রবার ও শনিবার উত্তর দিনাজপুর, কোচবিহার, আলিপুরদুয়ার এবং জলপাইগুড়ি জেলায় ভারী বৃষ্টির সতর্কতা রয়েছে। রবিবার ও সোমবার পরিস্থিতি আরও জটিল হতে পারে। আলিপুরদুয়ার ও জলপাইগুড়িতে অতি ভারী বৃষ্টির সম্ভাবনায় কমলা সতর্কতা জারি করা হয়েছে। পাশাপাশি দার্জিলিং, কালিম্পং এবং কোচবিহার জেলাতেও ভারী বৃষ্টির পূর্বাভাস রয়েছে।

কলকাতায় শনিবার থেকে সোমবার পর্যন্ত আকাশ আংশিক মেঘলা থাকবে। কোথাও কোথাও হালকা বা ঝিরঝিরে বৃষ্টি হতে পারে। তবে মঙ্গলবার থেকে বর্ষার সক্রিয়তা বাড়বে এবং শহরে বৃষ্টির পরিমাণ বৃদ্ধি পেতে পারে। বাতাসে আর্দ্রতার পরিমাণ বেশি থাকায় তাপমাত্রা খুব বেশি না হলেও ভ্যাপসা অস্বস্তি অনুভূত হতে পারে। শুক্রবার কলকাতার সর্বনিম্ন তাপমাত্রা ছিল ২১.১ ডিগ্রি সেলসিয়াস।

GEYZING,: The State Roads and Bridges department has clarified that construction of a steel bridge over Rungdung Khola in West Sikkim was suspended after flash floods triggered by heavy monsoon rains washed away construction materials and support structures.
The clarification comes after a video showing an elderly ailing woman being carried across a makeshift bamboo footbridge went viral on social media, highlighting the hardships faced by residents of the remote Rungdung village due to the absence of all-weather road connectivity.
The road carpeting and steel bridge construction over Rungdung Khola which connects one of the remotest villages of West Sikkim, Rungdung and beyond are being executed under Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY) through State Roads and Bridges department.
An assistant engineer under PMGSY, Om Prakash Gurung, informed that the road carpeting work up to and beyond Rungdung village has already been completed. However, he said the steel bridge construction had to be suspended due to the ongoing monsoon season. According to Gurung, construction of the bridge will resume in September this year.
He added that the department had recently commenced the bridge construction work. However, a flash flood triggered by heavy rainfall in the Rungdung Khola washed away construction some portion of materials along with the support poles installed in the stream to facilitate the bridge construction work, forcing the authorities to suspend the construction work for the time being.
Meanwhile, some residents of Rungdung village alleged that the absence of a bridge over the Rungdung Khola has completely disrupted the transport network to the village, causing immense hardship in the transportation of essential commodities and posing serious challenges during medical emergencies.
The villagers further alleged that the concerned department had adopted a lackadaisical approach towards the construction of the bridge, despite the demand remaining pending for the past five to six years. A resident claimed that the department invariably initiates the bridge construction work during the monsoon, even though it is well aware that such work over a fast-flowing stream is neither practical nor feasible during the rainy season. "The demand for a permanent bridge over Rungdung Khola is several years old, but it has yet to materialise due to the lackadaisical approach of the concerned department. Ironically, the department springs into action only during the rainy season, whereas bridge construction should ideally be undertaken during the dry season. Their negligence has caused us immense hardship for years," the villager alleged.
The villagers further stated that although the road construction work in Rungdung village has been completed, the condition of the road has deteriorated significantly due to landslides and erosion caused by natural forces. They alleged that major landslides at several locations have completely damaged sections of the road, rendering it unsafe and difficult for vehicular movement. The road restoration work appears to be urgent as it has suffered major damages at some stretches, said a villager.
Locals further stated that the lack of a bridge to ensure all weather road connectivity has virtually isolated the village, as there is no alternative route for vehicular movement across the swift-flowing Rungdung Khola. "Absence of a bridge has severely affected vehicular movement, causing numerous hardships for the local residents. Transporting essential goods to and from the villages across the stream has become a major challenge, while students and daily commuters are forced to use a makeshift bridge, exposing them to serious risks. The situation becomes even more critical during medical emergencies, as transporting sick and injured persons across the stream is both difficult and dangerous", a local said.
Before the bridge construction began, vehicles used to cross the stream through a causeway located upstream of the proposed steel bridge site, Gurung said. However, he explained that the recent rise in the stream's water level, coupled with a major landslide near the causeway has disrupted vehicular movement. He further stated that road clearance at the landslide affected site is currently not feasible, as the slope remains highly unstable and attempt to clear the debris at the site could pose a serious threat to the households located below the affected area. "The local panchayat members had also appealed the department to halt the clearance work at landslide affected site considering the threat of unstability of the slope and risks to the residential areas located below", Gurung said.
The affected villagers have demanded early completion of bridge construction over Rungdung Khola for mitigation of the problems being faced by the villagers and they have appealed for the immediate intervention of the higher authority in the matter.

देशभर में मॉनसून एक बार फिर पूरी तरह सक्रिय हो गया है। भारतीय मौसम विज्ञान विभाग (IMD) ने Weather Update Today जारी करते हुए गुजरात, महाराष्ट्र, बिहार, राजस्थान, दिल्ली, उत्तराखंड, हिमाचल प्रदेश, तेलंगाना, असम, मेघालय और कई अन्य राज्यों में भारी से बहुत भारी बारिश की चेतावनी दी है। Weather Update Today के अनुसार अगले 3 से 4 दिनों तक उत्तर, पश्चिम और मध्य भारत में सामान्य से अधिक बारिश होने की संभावना है। ऐसे में किसानों, यात्रियों और आम लोगों को मौसम विभाग की सलाह का पालन करने की जरूरत है।
IMD के अनुसार मॉनसून ट्रफ सामान्य स्थिति से दक्षिण की ओर बनी हुई है। पश्चिम-मध्य छत्तीसगढ़ के आसपास बना गहरा दबाव (Deep Depression) कमजोर होकर डिप्रेशन में बदलते हुए विदर्भ और दक्षिण मध्य प्रदेश की ओर बढ़ रहा है। इसी मौसम प्रणाली के प्रभाव से कई राज्यों में लगातार बारिश हो रही है। Weather Update Today के मुताबिक इस सिस्टम के कारण आने वाले दिनों में भी बारिश का दौर जारी रहने की संभावना है।
Weather Update Today के अनुसार दिल्ली-एनसीआर में पूरे दिन बादल छाए रहेंगे और दोपहर या शाम के समय हल्की से मध्यम बारिश हो सकती है। अधिकतम तापमान 33 से 35 डिग्री सेल्सियस तथा न्यूनतम तापमान 25 से 27 डिग्री सेल्सियस के बीच रहने का अनुमान है। 18 से 20 किलोमीटर प्रति घंटे की रफ्तार से हवाएं भी चल सकती हैं। मौसम विभाग ने गरज-चमक के दौरान खुले स्थानों से दूर रहने की सलाह दी है।
Weather Update Today के अनुसार गुजरात में 31 जुलाई से 2 अगस्त तक सूरत, अहमदाबाद, वडोदरा, भावनगर, भरूच, आणंद, नर्मदा, तापी, डांग, पंचमहल, दाहोद और महीसागर सहित कई जिलों में भारी से बहुत भारी बारिश का अलर्ट जारी किया गया है। प्रशासन को राहत और बचाव के लिए पूरी तैयारी रखने के निर्देश दिए गए हैं।
हिमाचल प्रदेश, उत्तराखंड, पंजाब, हरियाणा, दिल्ली और पश्चिमी राजस्थान में गरज-चमक के साथ बारिश होने की संभावना है। Weather Update Today के अनुसार पहाड़ी क्षेत्रों में भारी बारिश के कारण भूस्खलन और अचानक बाढ़ का खतरा भी बना रहेगा। यात्रियों को मौसम की जानकारी लेकर ही यात्रा करने की सलाह दी गई है।
पूर्वी और पश्चिमी मध्य प्रदेश, विदर्भ तथा छत्तीसगढ़ के कई इलाकों में लगातार बारिश होगी। Weather Update Today के मुताबिक पश्चिमी मध्य प्रदेश और विदर्भ के कुछ हिस्सों में भारी वर्षा दर्ज की जा सकती है। निचले इलाकों में जलभराव की स्थिति भी बन सकती है।
Weather Update Today के अनुसार बिहार में 31 जुलाई से 4 अगस्त तक अधिकांश जिलों में मध्यम से भारी बारिश होने का अनुमान है। इस दौरान 40 किलोमीटर प्रति घंटे तक की रफ्तार से तेज हवाएं भी चल सकती हैं। झारखंड, पश्चिम बंगाल और सिक्किम में भी कई स्थानों पर भारी बारिश की संभावना जताई गई है।
असम, मेघालय, अरुणाचल प्रदेश, नागालैंड, मणिपुर, मिजोरम और त्रिपुरा में गरज-चमक के साथ बारिश जारी रहेगी। Weather Update Today के अनुसार असम के तिनसुकिया, धेमाजी और लखीमपुर जिलों में सबसे अधिक बारिश होने की संभावना है। बाढ़ प्रभावित इलाकों में लोगों को अतिरिक्त सावधानी बरतने की सलाह दी गई है।
गुजरात, सौराष्ट्र-कच्छ, कोंकण-गोवा, मध्य महाराष्ट्र और मराठवाड़ा में तेज बारिश जारी रहेगी। वहीं तेलंगाना, केरल, तटीय कर्नाटक, आंतरिक कर्नाटक और तमिलनाडु के कई हिस्सों में भी अच्छी बारिश का अनुमान है। Weather Update Today के मुताबिक कोयंबटूर, नीलगिरि, थेनी और कन्याकुमारी के पहाड़ी इलाकों में भारी बारिश देखने को मिल सकती है।
धान की नर्सरी में तना छेदक की पहचान और बचाव के आसान उपाय
लगातार हो रही बारिश को देखते हुए किसानों को खेतों में जलभराव नहीं होने देना चाहिए। अतिरिक्त पानी की निकासी की उचित व्यवस्था करें ताकि फसलों की जड़ों को नुकसान न पहुंचे। Weather Update Today के अनुसार जिन क्षेत्रों में भारी बारिश का अलर्ट जारी किया गया है वहां फिलहाल बुवाई, सिंचाई, उर्वरक और कीटनाशकों का छिड़काव टाल देना चाहिए।धान, सोयाबीन, मक्का, कपास, अरहर, मूंग, उड़द और सब्जियों की फसलों में जल निकासी की व्यवस्था मजबूत रखें। कटाई के लिए तैयार फसलों को सुरक्षित स्थान पर रखें और पशुओं को खुले स्थानों में न छोड़ें।
भारतीय मौसम विज्ञान विभाग ने लोगों से अपील की है कि भारी बारिश, आंधी और बिजली गिरने की संभावना वाले क्षेत्रों में अनावश्यक यात्रा से बचें। Weather Update Today के अनुसार स्थानीय प्रशासन और मौसम विभाग द्वारा जारी ताजा अपडेट पर लगातार नजर रखें। अगले कुछ दिनों तक मॉनसून सक्रिय रहने के कारण कई राज्यों में तेज बारिश जारी रहने की संभावना है, इसलिए सतर्क रहना बेहद जरूरी है।

અમદાવાદ-નવી દિલ્હીઃ હવામાન વિભાગ અનુસાર વેસ્ટર્ન ડિસ્ટર્બન્સના કારણે ઉત્તર પશ્ચિમ ભારતમાં 13 તારીખ સુધી વરસાદનો પ્રભાવ જોવા મળશે. ગાજવીજ સાથે ભારે પવન અને કરા પણ પડશે. ઉત્તર પૂર્વના રાજ્યો તથા પશ્ચિમ બંગાળમાં આગામી પાંચથી સાત દિવસ એક બે સ્થળોએ 7 થી લઈ 20 સેમી સુધી વરસાદ પડી શકે છે. દક્ષિણ ભારતના કેરળ, કર્ણાટક, તમિલનાડુમાં ભારે વરસાદનું પૂર્વાનુમાન છે. ગુજરાતમાં ચોમાસાના આગમન પહેલા મોટા ભાગના વિસ્તારમાં વાદળછાયું વાતાવરણ જોવા મળી રહ્યું છે. દક્ષિણ ગુજરાતમાં છૂટાછવાયા સ્થળોએ  હળવા વરસાદી ઝાપટાં પડી રહ્યા છે.

 

ગુજરાતમાં કેવું રહેશે હવામાન

 

આજે સુરત સહિત દક્ષિણ ગુજરાતમાં પવન સાથે વરસાદની શક્યતા વ્યક્ત કરવામાં આવી છે. 16 જૂન સુધી દક્ષિણ ગુજરાત, સૌરાષ્ટ્ર અને મધ્ય ગુજરાતમાં છૂટાછવાયા સ્થળોએ હળવાથી મધ્યમ વરસાદની શક્યતા છે. નૈઋત્યનું ચોમાસું ગુજરાત તરફ ધીમે ધીમે આગળ વધી રહ્યું છે, જેના પગલે સક્રિય થયેલી વરસાદી સિસ્ટમ રાજ્યના વિવિધ ભાગોમાં જોવા મળી શકે છે. 12 થી 16 જૂન દરમિયાન દક્ષિણ ગુજરાત, મધ્ય ગુજરાત અને સૌરાષ્ટ્રમાં છૂટાછવાયા સ્થળોએ હળવોથી મધ્યમ વરસાદ વરસી શકે છે. અમદાવાદમાં આજે મહત્તમ તાપમાન 42 ડિગ્રી આસપાસ રહી શકે છે. લોકોને કાળઝાળ ગરમી અને બફારાનો અનુભવ થશે.

 

ચોમાસું ક્યાં પહોંચ્યું?

 

ચોમાસું આગામી ત્રણથી ચાર દિવસમાં મહારાષ્ટ્ર, કર્ણાટક, તેલંગાણા, આંધ્રપ્રદેશમાં આગળ વધી શકે છે અને તમિલનાડુના બાકીના ભાગોને પણ આવરી શકે છે. આ દરમિયાન છત્તીસગઢ, બિહાર, ઝારખંડ, ઓડિશાના કેટલાક ભાગોમાં ચોમાસું દસ્તક આપી શકે છે. ચોમાસાને આગળ વધવા માટે સાનુકૂળ પરિસ્થિતિઓ છે. વેસ્ટર્ન ડિસ્ટર્બન્સના કારણે મધ્ય ભાગમાં લો પ્રેશર સર્જાયું છે. આ કારણે ઉત્તર-પશ્ચિમ ભારતમાં આગામી 24 કલાકમાં તાપમાનમાં કોઈ મોટો ફેરફાર જોવા નહીં મળે. ત્યારબાદ 13 તારીખ સુધી પારો 3 થી 5 ડિગ્રી સેલ્સિયસ સુધી ગગડી શકે છે. જે પછી તાપમાન ફરીથી 2 થી 4 ડિગ્રી સુધી વધી શકે છે. દેશના મધ્ય ભાગમાં આગામી 3 દિવસ એટલે કે 12 તારીખ સુધી તાપમાનમાં બહુ ફેરફાર જોવા નહીં મળે, પરંતુ ત્યારબાદ તાપમાનમાં 2 થી 3 ડિગ્રી સુધીનો ઘટાડો જોવા મળી શકે છે. પૂર્વ ભારતમાં 2 દિવસ સુધી તાપમાનમાં ખાસ ફેરફાર નહીં થાય. ત્યારબાદ 12 થી 14 તારીખ વચ્ચે તાપમાનમાં 2 થી 4 ડિગ્રી સુધીનો ઘટાડો થઈ શકે છે.

 

 

 

મધ્યપ્રદેશ-બિહારમાં ઓરેન્જ એલર્ટ

 

પૂર્વી મધ્યપ્રદેશ, ઝારખંડ, ઓડિશા અને બિહાર, પશ્ચિમ બંગાળ, આસામ, મેઘાલયમાં ઓરેન્જ એલર્ટ જાહેર કરવામાં આવ્યું છે. આ સાથે અંદામાન અને નિકોબાર ટાપુઓમાં પણ ઓરેન્જ એલર્ટ અપાયું છે. ગાજવીજ સાથે વીજળી અને તેજ પવનની અસર જોવા મળશે. આસામ, મેઘાલય, પશ્ચિમ બંગાળ અને સિક્કિમમાં એક કે બે સ્થળોએ ભારે વરસાદ પડી શકે છે. ભારે વરસાદની અસર અરૂણાચલ પ્રદેશ, નાગાલેન્ડ, મણિપુર, ત્રિપુરા, તેલંગાણા, કર્ણાટક, દક્ષિણ કોંકણ, દરિયાકાંઠાના કર્ણાટક, કેરળ, તમિલનાડુ અને લક્ષદ્વીપમાં જોવા મળશે. કર્ણાટક, ગોવા, કેરળમાં 30 થી 40 કિમીની ઝડપે પવન ફૂંકાઈ શકે છે.

 

યુપી-કાશ્મીરમાં હીટવેવનો પ્રકોપ યથાવત રહેશે

 

જમ્મુ-કાશ્મીર, હિમાચલ પ્રદેશ, ઉત્તર પ્રદેશ, પંજાબ, હરિયાણા, રાજસ્થાનમાં હીટવેવનો પ્રકોપ ચાલુ રહેશે. વેસ્ટર્ન ડિસ્ટર્બન્સના કારણે જમ્મુ-કાશ્મીર, પંજાબ, હરિયાણા, ઉત્તર પ્રદેશ અને ઉત્તરાખંડમાં કરા પડી શકે છે. આ તમામ સ્થળોએ ઓરેન્જ એલર્ટ જાહેર કરવામાં આવ્યું છે. રાજસ્થાન અને ઉત્તર પ્રદેશમાં એક-બે સ્થળોએ ધૂળની ડમરીઓ સાથે આંધી આવવાની સંભાવના છે. પૂર્વ ભારતમાં ભારે પવન અને ગાજવીજ સાથે વીજળીનો પ્રભાવ જોવા મળી શકે છે.

ગુજરાતમાં આજથી બે દિવસ સુધી ભારેથી અત્યંત ભારે વરસાદની આગાહી કરાઈ છે. આગાહીને પગલે આખા ગુજરાતમાં વહીવટીતંત્ર પણ સતર્ક થયું છે.

આગાહી અનુસાર, આણંદ શહેરમાં વહેલી સવારે ભારે પવન સાથે ધોધમાર વરસાદ શરૂ થઈ ગયો છે. શહેરના નીચાણવાળા વિસ્તારમાં પાણી ભરાયાં છે.

તો વડોદરા શહેરમાં વહેલી સવારથી ધોધમાર વરસાદ શરૂ થયો છે. તો સુરત શહેર અને તેની આસપાસના વિસ્તારોમાં પણ વરસાદ શરૂ થઈ ગયો છે.

બે દિવસ ભારેથી અતિભારે વરસાદની આગાહીને કારણે સંબંધિત જિલ્લામાં શાળાઓમાં રજા અપાઈ છે.

ઇમેજ કૅપ્શન,
અતિભારે વરસાદની આગાહીના પગલે નર્મદા જિલ્લા વહીવટી તંત્ર સંતર્ક થયું છે. નર્મદા નદીના ઉત્તર-દક્ષિણ વિસ્તારમાં એનડીઆરએફ અને એસડીઆરએફની ટીમો અને 26 બોટ તહેનાત કરાઈ છે

રાજ્યમાં ભારે વરસાદની આગાહીને પગલે વહીવટીતંત્ર અને પોલીસ તંત્ર સતર્ક બન્યું છે. ગુજરાત સરકારની પ્રેસ રિલીઝ અનુસાર, નીચાણવાળા વિસ્તારોમાંથી નાગરિકોની સાથે પશુધનને પણ સુરક્ષિત સ્થળે ખસેડવા માટે વિવિધ વિભાગો સાથે મળીને સંયુક્ત 'ઇવેક્યુએશન પ્લાન' બનાવાયો છે.

તેમજ રાષ્ટ્રીય અને રાજ્ય ધોરીમાર્ગો પર ટ્રાફિક નિયમન માટે પોલીસ જવાનો તહેનાત કરાયા છે.

ગુજરાત રાજ્યના પોલીસવડા જી.એસ. મલિકના અધ્યક્ષસ્થાને વીડિયો કૉન્ફરન્સ થઈ હતી અને તેમાં રાજ્યનાં તમામ શહેર, જિલ્લા અને રેન્જ વડાઓને સતર્ક રહેવા સૂચના અપાઈ છે.

એનડીઆરએફ અને એસડીઆરએફની ટીમો સાથે સંકલન સાધીને સ્થાનિક પોલીસને પણ કામગીરીમાં જોડવામાં આવી છે.

સંવેદનશીલ સ્થળો પર પોલીસ, હોમગાર્ડ્સ, જીઆરજી, ટીઆરબી અને ફાયર સર્વિસના જવાનોને અગાઉથી જ ખડેપગે કરી દેવાયા છે.

હવામાન વિભાગની આગાહી મુજબ સુરતમાં ગુરુવારની રાતથી જ વરસાદ શરૂ થઈ ગયો હતો અને શુક્રવારે સવારે પણ વરસાદ ચાલુ છે.

સવારે છ વાગ્યા સુધીમાં અલગ-અલગ ઝોનમાં ચારથી સાત મિમી વરસાદ નોંધાયો હતો અને હજુ પણ ચાલુ છે. 31 જુલાઈની સ્થિતિ પ્રમાણે સુરતમાં ચાલુ ચોમાસાની સિઝનમાં અત્યાર સુધીમાં 1382 મિમી એટલે કે લગભગ 54 ઇંચ કરતાં વધારે વરસાદ પડી ગયો છે.

સુરત મ્યુનિસિપલ કૉર્પોરેશનના ડેટા પ્રમાણે તાપી નદી પર આવેલા ઉકાઈ ડેમની સપાટી આજે સવારે છ વાગ્યે 316.51 ફૂટ હતી. હાલમાં ડૅમમાં 11689 ક્યુસેકનો પ્રવાહ આવી રહ્યો છે જ્યારે 800 ક્યુસેકની જાવક છે. ઉકાઈ ડેમની ફૂલ સપાટી 345 ફૂટ છે.

સુરતના અલગ-અલગ વિસ્તારોમાં પૂર માટે જવાબદાર ગણાતી પાંચેય ખાડીઓમાં હાલની સ્થિતિમાં પાણી નિયંત્રણ હેઠળ છે. પરંતુ વરસાદ ચાલુ રહે તો તેમાં પાણીનું સ્તર વધવાની પૂરી શક્યતા છે.

સુરતના મ્યુનિસિપલ કમિશનર એમ નાગરાજને એએનઆઇને જણાવ્યું હતું કે બંગાળની ખાડી પરથી વાવાઝોડું આવવાની શક્યતાના કારણે સુરત હાઈ ઍલર્ટ પર છે.

તેમણે કહ્યું કે સુરત શહેર અને જિલ્લા માટે રેડ ઍલર્ટ જાહેર કરવામાં આવ્યું છે. એનડીઆરએફ અને એસડીઆરએફની ટીમો તૈયાર રાખવામાં આવી છે. જરૂર પડશે તો વધુ ટીમો ગોઠવવામાં આવશે. 150 હોર્ડિંગ અને 100 જોખમી ઝાડોને હટાવાયાં છે. નીચાણવાળા વિસ્તારોમાં શેલ્ટર હોમ શરૂ કરવામાં આવ્યા છે.

કયા કયા જિલ્લામાં શાળાઓમાં રજા રખાઈ?

ભારે વરસાદની આગાહીના પગલે સુરત, અમદાવાદ, વડોદરા, ભાવનગર, મહીસાગર, છોટા ઉદેપુર, મહેસાણા, પંચમહાલ, વલસાડ જિલ્લામાં શાળાઓમાં રજા જાહેર કરવામાં આવી છે.

તો અમદાવાદ મ્યુનિસિપલ કૉર્પોરેશનના તમામ અધિકારીઓ-કર્મચારીઓની રજા રદ કરી દેવાઈ છે અને 31 જુલાઈ અને પહેલી ઑગસ્ટે શાળા-કૉલેજો અને આંગણવાડીઓ બંધ રાખવાના નિર્ણય લેવામાં આવ્યો છે.

અમદાવાદના મ્યુનિસિપલ કમિશનર બંછાનિધિ પાનીએ મીડિયાને જણાવ્યું કે નગરજનોએ બિનજરૂરી બહાર નીકળવાનું ટાળવું જોઈએ અને ખાનગી સંસ્થાઓ શક્ય હોય ત્યાં સુધી વર્ક ફ્રોમ હોમને પ્રાધાન્ય આપે.

ખેડા જિલ્લામાં આજે અને આવતી કાલે શાળા-કૉલેજ આંગણવાડીઓ બંધ રહેશે.

પંચમહાલ જિલ્લામાં પણ તમામ પ્રાથમિક શાળા અને આંગણવાડીઓમાં 31 જુલાઈએ રજા રખાઈ છે.

મહેસાણા જિલ્લામાં 31 જુલાઈના રોજ તમામ શાળાઓ બંધ રહેશે.

ભરૂચ જિલ્લામાં 31મી જુલાઈએ જિલ્લાની તમામ શાળાઓમાં રજા રખાઈ છે.

તેમજ કેટલીક જગ્યાએ નોકરીયાત લોકોને ઘરેથી કામ કરવાની અપીલ પણ કરાઈ છે.

વરસાદી સિસ્ટમ આગળ વધી, આગામી 24 કલાક મહત્ત્વના

ઇમેજ સ્રોત,
IMD

હવામાન વિભાગ અનુસાર, ગુજરાત માટે આગામી 24થી 48 કલાક મહત્ત્વના માનવામાં આવે છે, કેમ કે એટલા સમયગાળા દરમિયાન બનેલી વરસાદી સિસ્ટમ ગુજરાતમાં ભારેથી અતિભારે વરસાદ લાવે તેવી શક્યતા છે.

ગઈ કાલે છત્તીસગઢના મધ્ય ભાગો અને નજીકના ઉત્તર ઓડિશા પર બનેલું ડીપ ડિપ્રેશન છેલ્લા 6 કલાક દરમિયાન 12 કિમી પ્રતિ કલાકની ઝડપે પશ્ચિમ તરફ અને ત્યાર બાદ દક્ષિણ-પશ્ચિમ તરફ આગળ વધ્યું હતું.

તે છત્તીસગઢમાં લગભગ પશ્ચિમ તરફ આગળ વધવાની શક્યતા છે, એ પછી આગામી 12 કલાકમાં ધીમેધીમે ડિપ્રેશનમાં ફેરવાય તેવી સંભાવના છે.

એ પછી આગામી 24 કલાક દરમિયાન તે વિદર્ભ અને દક્ષિણ મધ્ય પ્રદેશમાં ડિપ્રેશન તરીકે પશ્ચિમ-ઉત્તર-પશ્ચિમ તરફ આગળ વધવાની શક્યતા છે.

સરેરાશ દરિયાઈ સપાટી પરનો એક ઑફ-શોર ટ્રક દક્ષિણ ગુજરાતથી કેરળ સુધી ફેલાયેલો છે.

ગુજરાતમાં આગામી કલાકોમાં ક્યાં ક્યાં ભારેથી અતિભારે વરસાદ પડશે?

ગુજરાત હવામાન વિભાગની આગાહી અનુસાર, ગુજરાતમાં આગામી કેટલાક કલાકોમાં વરસાદનું જોર વધશે. એટલે કે કેટલાક વિસ્તારોમાં અતિભારે વરસાદની પણ શક્યતા છે.

હવામાન વિભાગ અનુસાર, 31 જુલાઈએ અમદાવાદ, બોટાદ, ભાવનગર, આણંદ, વડોદરા, છોટા ઉદેપુર, ભરૂચ, નર્મદા, સુરત, તાપી, નવસારી, વલસાડ, દમણ, દાદરા અને નગરહવેલી અને ડાંગમાં છૂટાંછવાયાં સ્થળોએ અત્યંત ભારેથી અસાધારણ વરસાદનું અનુમાન છે.

તેમજ ગાંધીનગર, ખેડા, પંચમહાલ, દાહોદમાં છૂટાછવાયા વિસ્તારોમાં ભારેથી અતિભારે વરસાદની ચેતવણી અપાઈ છે.

આ સિવાયના મોટા ભાગના જિલ્લામાં 31 જુલાઈએ કેટલાંક સ્થળોએ ભારે વરસાદની ચેતવણી અપાઈ છે.

તો ઑગસ્ટ મહિનાની શરૂઆતમાં પણ ગુજરાતમાં વરસાદનું જોર યથાવત્ રહેવું તેવું હવામાન વિભાગનું અનુમાન છે.

પહેલી ઑગસ્ટે અમદાવાદ, સુરેન્દ્રનગર, રાજકોટ અને આણંદ જિલ્લામાં અત્યંત ભારે વરસાદની આગાહી છે.

KARNATAKA
Orange alert in 16 Karnataka districts as heavy rain, strong winds forecast
IMD issues orange alert for 16 Karnataka districts predicting heavy rain and winds up to 60 kmph. Coastal areas on high alert; fishermen warned. Bengaluru to see cloudy skies with moderate rain.
Archana Reddy
 31 Jul 2026 10:27 IST
Orange alert issued for 16 districts statewide
Winds up to 60 kmph, heavy rain likely
Fishermen warned against venturing into rough seas
Heavy rain alert in 16 districts with winds up to 60 kmph. Coastal warning issued, fishermen advised caution. Bengaluru likely to get moderate rain

The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued an orange alert for 16 districts across Karnataka, warning of heavy rainfall and strong winds in the coming days. The alert signals the likelihood of intense weather conditions, prompting authorities to remain on high alert.

Districts placed under orange alert include Bidar, Kalaburagi, Yadgir, Vijayapura, Raichur, Bagalkote, Koppal, Belagavi, Gadag, Dharwad, Haveri, Uttara Kannada, Udupi, Dakshina Kannada, Shivamogga, and Chikkamagaluru. In these regions, wind speeds are expected to range between 40 and 60 kmph, accompanied by heavy rainfall.

The weather department has cautioned that strong gusty winds and intense showers may cause disruptions, especially in coastal and hilly regions. Along the Karnataka coastline, wind speeds could touch up to 60 kmph, increasing the risk of rough sea conditions. Fishermen have been strictly advised not to venture into the sea until conditions improve.

Meanwhile, yellow alert has been issued for the remaining districts, indicating the possibility of moderate rainfall accompanied by steady winds. Authorities have urged residents to exercise caution, particularly in areas prone to waterlogging and localized flooding.

In Bengaluru, the weather is expected to remain cloudy with light to moderate rainfall. Wind speeds in the city may range between 30 and 40 kmph, bringing relatively mild but consistent showers.

The IMD has also indicated that heavy rainfall is likely to continue in parts of the state on Saturday, with Shivamogga, Chikkamagaluru, and Dakshina Kannada expected to remain under orange alert. Other districts will continue under yellow alert as the wet spell persists.

Officials are closely monitoring the situation and have advised citizens to stay updated with weather advisories and take necessary precautions to ensure safety.

या बाधित भागांतील नागरिकांनी सतर्क राहावे. सखल भागात पाणी साचण्याची शक्यता असून, नदीकाठच्या व सखल भागात राहणाऱ्या नागरिकांनी आवश्यक ती खबरदारी घ्यावी. जळगाव जिल्ह्यात ८२ मिमी पावसाचा अंदाज असून, नदी प्रवाह सामान्य पातळीच्या तुलनेत निगराणीखाली ठेवण्यात आला आहे. प्रवास करताना विशेष काळजी घेण्याचा सल्ला दिला जातो, कारण अचानक येणाऱ्या पुरामुळे वाहतुकीवर परिणाम होऊ शकतो.

ही इशारा प्रणाली नदी प्रवाह आणि पर्जन्यमानाचा अंदाज दर्शविणाऱ्या मॉडेल्सवर आधारित आहे. हवामानातील बदलानुसार परिस्थितीत बदल होऊ शकतो, त्यामुळे नागरिकांनी पुढील सूचनांकडे लक्ष ठेवावे.

Weather Updates: मौसम विज्ञान विभाग (आईएमडी) ने हरियाणा पंजाब को लेकर नया अलर्ट जारी किया है। शुक्रवार को जारी बुलेटिन में बताया गया कि इन इलाकों में बारिश के साथ आंधी-तूफान, बिजली कड़कने और तेज हवाओं के भी चलने का अनुमान है। पूर्वी विदर्भ और पश्चिम-मध्य छत्तीसगढ़ के ऊपर बना कम दबाव का क्षेत्र पश्चिम की ओर बढ़ गया है और सुबह 5:30 बजे तक मध्य विदर्भ और दक्षिण मध्य प्रदेश के ऊपर केंद्रित हो गया है। इस प्रणाली के अगले 24 घंटों में विदर्भ और दक्षिण मध्य प्रदेश से होते हुए पश्चिम-उत्तर-पश्चिम दिशा में आगे बढ़ने की उम्मीद है, जिससे देश के अधिकांश हिस्सों में मानसून की सक्रियता बनी रहेगी।

title: July monsoon wipes out rainfall deficit - Rising Kashmir
article_text:
Top Stories
July monsoon wipes out rainfall deficit
J&K records 23% above-normal rains Amarnath Yatra to remain uninterrupted in coming days
Abid Bashir
 31 Jul 2026 02:40 IST
 Follow Us

Srinagar, Jul 30: Active monsoon conditions have dramatically transformed Jammu and Kashmir’s rainfall scenario, with the Union Territory recording 23 per cent above-normal precipitation in July, effectively wiping out the 32 per cent seasonal rainfall deficit that persisted till the end of May.

Speaking to Rising Kashmir, Director Meteorological Department Srinagar, Dr Mukhtar Ahmad said the active monsoon has brought widespread rainfall across the Union Territory, significantly improving the overall precipitation pattern after months of below-normal rainfall.

"Till the end of May, J&K was facing a 32 per cent rainfall deficit. However, sustained monsoon activity during July has completely changed the picture, and the Union Territory has now recorded 23 per cent above-normal precipitation during the month," he said.

Despite the overall improvement, Dr Ahmad said rainfall distribution has remained uneven.

"Kathua and Kishtwar districts in Jammu division and Shopian and some parts of Budgam in Kashmir Valley continue to record below-normal precipitation, while almost all other districts have received normal to above-normal rainfall," he said.

The MeT Director said the monsoon is expected to remain active over the coming days, with Jammu division likely to receive more intense rainfall than Kashmir Valley.

"Rain spells will be more effective over the Jammu region till August 5, and heavy showers at isolated places could trigger landslides, mudslides and shooting stones in vulnerable areas, particularly along hilly roads," he warned.

In contrast, Kashmir Valley is likely to witness only light to moderate showers, with no significant weather activity expected till August 5, he said.

Dr Ahmad also expressed confidence that the Amarnath Yatra is expected to continue without any major weather-related disruption, as no severe weather system is presently forecast over the pilgrimage routes.

"The weather forecast for the Yatra has improved considerably. At present, there is no significant weather activity likely to affect the pilgrimage," he said.

Highlighting the technological advancements introduced for the annual pilgrimage, Dr Ahmad said the Meteorological Department has installed nine automated weather stations along the twin routes to the holy cave shrine via Pahalgam and Baltal.

"We have established nine weather stations along both axes of the Amarnath Yatra. These are supported by Doppler weather radars and high-resolution numerical weather prediction models, enabling us to monitor weather conditions in real time," he said.

According to him, the network provides fresh weather observations every 10 minutes, allowing forecasters to issue timely nowcasts, three-day forecasts and seven-day outlooks specifically for the pilgrimage routes.

"We receive updated weather data every 10 minutes, which has significantly enhanced the accuracy of route-specific forecasts and weather advisories," he said.

Dr Ahmad clarified, however, that cloudbursts cannot be predicted with absolute certainty anywhere in the world.

"No forecasting tool can predict the exact occurrence of a cloudburst. What modern Doppler radars and high-resolution models can do is identify areas where dense cloud formation and intense rainfall are likely. Such conditions may eventually develop into a cloudburst," he explained.

He said the advanced monitoring systems generally provide 15 to 20 minutes of lead time, enabling authorities to issue warnings and take precautionary measures whenever intense weather develops.

"Weather forecasting has always been challenging, particularly in mountainous terrain like the Himalayas. Nevertheless, technological advancements have considerably improved our ability to monitor rapidly evolving weather systems," he said.

Citing a recent example, Dr Ahmad said the department had accurately forecast very heavy rainfall over the Pir Panjal range, allowing authorities to remain prepared before the event unfolded.

"Our prediction regarding intense rainfall over the Pir Panjal range proved accurate. Such forecasts demonstrate the significant improvements achieved through enhanced observational infrastructure and advanced forecasting models," he said.

title: The recent rainfall incidents have battered Jammu and Kashmir with an unusually intense monsoon, with the persistent occurrence of flash floods and landslides — mostly concentrated in the first three weeks of the month — leaving widespread death and dest - News Arena India
article_text:
The recent rainfall incidents have battered Jammu and Kashmir with an unusually intense monsoon, with the persistent occurrence of flash floods and landslides — mostly concentrated in the first three weeks of the month — leaving widespread death and destruction, particularly across the Jammu division.
According to official figures, the death count stands at around 28-30, with roughly six people still missing as search operations continue in Poonch and Rajouri.
Poonch has suffered the heaviest losses, followed by Rajouri and Doda, while the Kashmir Valley recorded comparatively fewer deaths. Entire families in Poonch were wiped out in flash floods, and a landslide buried a house in the Domail Dhok area.
Infrastructure damage has been extensive: hundreds of roads, bridges and river embankments were destroyed; key highways were shut for days; shops and vehicles were swept away; and power, water and communication lines were cut for days in rural pockets. Besides, major pilgrimages, including the Amarnath Yatra and Vaishno Devi Yatra, were suspended.
Experts describe this as a compound disaster rather than ordinary heavy rain. According to IIT Roorkee’s Prof. Ankit Agarwal, active monsoon conditions combined with a western disturbance over Jammu pulled moisture into the western Himalayas, while strong orographic lifting intensified rainfall. Repeated wet spells also left soils saturated, meaning even moderate rain can now trigger rapid flooding and landslides.
Prof. Anuradha Sharma of Jammu University points to climate change enabling the atmosphere to hold more moisture, pushing monsoon rainfall further inland towards areas like Ladakh. The region’s steep, geologically fragile terrain drains poorly, while settlements built along riverbanks and slopes heighten the risk.
Kashmir received around 325 per cent above-normal rainfall between July 17 and July 23 alone, with at least a dozen cloudbursts recorded recently. Authorities have identified 654 vulnerable villages, home to roughly 7.22 lakh people, across high-risk districts, including Rajouri, Poonch, Reasi and Doda.
All of these factors combined — including rapid urbanisation, development activities, the creation of infrastructure such as dams, bridges and tunnels, and the conversion of forest land for commercial purposes — are contributing to the intensity and frequency of weather-related deaths and destruction in climate-sensitive regions such as Jammu and Kashmir.

Pakistan monsoon death toll rises to 121 since June as heavy rains continue
NAIMAT KHAN
30 July 2026
   
People along with a herd of goats wade through a flooded area after heavy monsoon rains induced a rise in the water level of the Ravi river in Pakistan's Muridke on July 28, 2026. (AFP)
Short Url

https://arab.news/vyuxh

Eight people killed in house collapses and drowning incidents over past 24 hours
Officials warn of more heavy rains as emergency response, rescue operations continue

ISLAMABAD: Pakistan’s monsoon death toll rose to 121 on Thursday after eight more people died in rain-related incidents over the past 24 hours, disaster management authorities said, warning of more heavy rainfall and flash floods across parts of the country.

Since the start of the monsoon season on June 26, the rains have killed 121 people and injured 381 others while damaging 901 houses, washing away roads and bridges and triggering rescue operations across several provinces. The latest fatalities come as forecasters warn of another spell of heavy rain in the coming days, raising concerns of further flooding and infrastructure damage.

Seven of the latest deaths were reported in Punjab, Pakistan’s most populous province, where six people were killed in house collapses and one drowned. One person also drowned in Azad Jammu and Kashmir, the Pakistan-administered part of the disputed Himalayan region.

“The committee reviewed the response measures undertaken by federal ministries, provincial governments and district administrations, and acknowledged their tireless efforts in safeguarding communities, conducting rescue operations, providing relief assistance and restoring essential services in affected areas,” the National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA) said after a meeting of the federal Emergency Response Committee chaired by Planning Minister Ahsan Iqbal.

The committee also reviewed the latest hydrological situation and potential weather hazards, with authorities directing all government departments to maintain close coordination, sustain preparedness measures and expedite relief and rehabilitation efforts in affected areas.

Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province has reported the highest number of monsoon deaths this season with 55, followed by Punjab with 45, Azad Jammu and Kashmir with 10, Balochistan with eight, Sindh with two and Gilgit-Baltistan with one.

The NDMA said another 91 houses were damaged during the past 24 hours, including 25 destroyed and 66 partially damaged. Flash floods also swept away two suspension bridges and three footbridges in Diamer district in the northern Gilgit-Baltistan region, while rescue teams carried out 11 operations in Punjab, bringing the total number of people rescued since June 26 to 4,127.

Pakistan’s Meteorological Department has forecast widespread rain, thunderstorms and isolated heavy to very heavy downpours until Aug. 4, warning of possible flash floods in mountainous areas and urban flooding in several cities.

Pakistan is among the countries considered most vulnerable to climate change and has experienced increasingly erratic weather in recent years, with more frequent heatwaves, droughts and extreme monsoon rainfall.

In 2025, above-average monsoon rains and flooding killed more than 1,000 people and caused widespread damage to homes, roads, agricultural land and public infrastructure, with Punjab among the hardest-hit provinces.

In 2022, record monsoon rains and glacial melt triggered catastrophic floods that killed more than 1,700 people, affected over 33 million people and caused an estimated $30 billion in economic losses, making it one of Pakistan’s worst natural disasters.

Chhattisgarh Mausam Update: छत्तीसगढ़ में मानसून का असर लगातार बना हुआ है. बीते 24 घंटों में प्रदेश के अधिकांश जिलों में हल्की से मध्यम बारिश दर्ज की गई, जबकि दक्षिण छत्तीसगढ़ और मध्य छत्तीसगढ़ के कुछ हिस्सों में भारी बारिश हुई. मौसम विभाग का अनुमान है कि अगले 24 घंटे तक दक्षिण छत्तीसगढ़ में तेज बारिश का सिलसिला जारी रह सकता है. वहीं बीजापुर जिले में लगातार हो रही भारी बारिश से बाढ़ जैसे हालात बने हुए हैं. जिसे देखते हुए  जिला प्रशासन ने 31 जुलाई से 1 अगस्त तक सभी सरकारी और प्राइवेट स्कूलों के साथ-साथ आंगनबाड़ी केंद्रों में छुट्टी  घोषणा की है. स्थिति को देखते हुए मुख्यमंत्री विष्णु देव साय ने सभी जिला कलेक्टरों, पुलिस अधीक्षकों और संबंधित विभागों के अधिकारियों को हाई अलर्ट पर रहने के निर्देश दिए हैं.
छत्तीसगढ़ के बीजापुर जिले में लगातार हो रही भारी बारिश और बाढ़ जैसे हालात को देखते हुए, जिला प्रशासन ने 31 जुलाई-1 अगस्त को सभी सरकारी और प्राइवेट स्कूलों के साथ-साथ आंगनबाड़ी केंद्रों में छुट्टी की घोषणा की है. जिले के कई हिस्सों में नदियां और नाले उफान पर हैं, जिससे आवागमन बाधित हो रहा है. इसे ध्यान में रखते हुए, प्राइमरी, मिडिल, हाई स्कूल और हायर सेकेंडरी स्तर के सभी स्कूलों के लिए दो दिन की छुट्टी घोषित की गई है.
मौसम विभाग के अनुसार बस्तर डिवीजन के ज्यादातर जिलों में अगले 24 घंटों में अच्छी बारिश होने की संभावना है. कुछ जिलों में तेज बारिश के साथ आंधी-तूफान भी आ सकता है. रायपुर, दुर्ग और मध्य छत्तीसगढ़ के कुछ जिलों में भी मध्यम बारिश जारी रहने की उम्मीद है. लोगों को नदियों, नालों और पानी भरे इलाकों के पास सावधानी बरतने की सलाह दी गई है.
छत्तीसगढ़ के कई जिलों में लगातार हो रही बारिश और मौसम विभाग द्वारा कई जिलों के लिए जारी रेड और येलो अलर्ट को देखते हुए मुख्यमंत्री विष्णु देव साय ने सभी जिला कलेक्टरों, पुलिस अधीक्षकों और संबंधित विभागों के अधिकारियों को हाई अलर्ट पर रहने का निर्देश दिया है. सीएम साय ने कहा कि नागरिकों की सुरक्षा राज्य सरकार की सर्वोच्च प्राथमिकता है. आपदा प्रबंधन राहत कार्यों में किसी भी तरह की लापरवाही बर्दाश्त नहीं की जाएगी. उन्होंने सभी जिला कलेक्टरों को निर्देश दिया कि वे संभावित बाढ़ और जलभराव वाले इलाकों पर लगातार नजर रखें, जोखिम वाली जगहों की पहचान करें और जरूरी एहतियाती उपाय करें. इसके साथ ही एनडीआरएफ, एसडीआरएफ, पुलिस और सभी विभागों को समन्वय के साथ तैयार रहने को कहा गया है.
मौसम वैज्ञानिकों के अनुसार पश्चिम-मध्य छत्तीसगढ़ और उससे सटे दक्षिण-पूर्वी मध्य प्रदेश के इलाके में बना कम दबाव का क्षेत्र पिछले 24 घंटों में कमजोर होकर डिप्रेशन में बदल गया है. जैसे-जैसे यह सिस्टम धीरे-धीरे उत्तर-पश्चिम दिशा की ओर बढ़ेगा, यह और कमजोर होता जाएगा. इसके असर से राज्य में नमी का स्तर तो अभी ज्यादा बना रहेगा, लेकिन अगले दो दिनों में बारिश की तेजी कम होने की उम्मीद है.
दक्षिणी छत्तीसगढ़ के ज्यादातर जिलों में अच्छी बारिश की उम्मीद है और कुछ इलाकों में भारी से बहुत भारी बारिश हो सकती है. मध्य और उत्तरी छत्तीसगढ़ में हल्की से मध्यम बारिश होने की संभावना है.राज्य के कई हिस्सों में हल्की से मध्यम बारिश होगी, लेकिन दक्षिणी जिलों के कुछ इलाकों में तेज बारिश के साथ आंधी-तूफान जारी रह सकता है.
पूरे राज्य में बारिश की गतिविधि कम होने की उम्मीद है. ज्यादातर जिलों में मौसम बदला रहेगा और कुछ जगहों पर हल्की बारिश या गरज के साथ बौछारें पड़ सकती हैं. 2 अगस्त के बाद मानसून कमजोर पड़ सकता है.
